**AltaVista** was a web search engine founded in **1995** and later acquired by **Yahoo**; the original **altavista.com** domain was eventually redirected and the service became **defunct in 2013**.[1]

If you meant the current status of **altavista.com**, it no longer functions as the original AltaVista search engine and was redirected to Yahoo Search before being retired.[1]

**AltaVista** was a web search engine founded in **1995** and later acquired by **Yahoo**; the original **altavista.com** domain was eventually redirected and the service became **defunct in 2013**.[1]

If you meant the current status of **altavista.com**, it no longer functions as the original AltaVista search engine and was redirected to Yahoo Search before being retired.[1]
